description: A required fact that is absent is BLOCK required_facts, never a default and never permission.
A required number given as a string is invalid: BLOCK.
An integer fact given a fraction is invalid: BLOCK.
A number below its declared min is invalid: BLOCK.
null is not a value: BLOCK.
A time that is not "HH:MM" 24h is invalid: BLOCK.
A day outside mon..sun is invalid: BLOCK.
An enum value not in the declared list is invalid: BLOCK, even though the fact has a default.
A boolean given as a string is invalid: BLOCK.
An optional fact, when given, must still be valid: a negative speedAsked is BLOCK.
approvedBy must be a non-empty string or an object with an id: true is invalid.
A request with no facts object at all is incomplete: BLOCK required_facts.
An area the rulebook does not declare is BLOCK area_declared.
A role the rulebook does not declare is BLOCK role_declared.
A declared role claimed under the wrong kind is BLOCK role_declared.
A participant kind the rulebook does not declare is an incomplete request: BLOCK required_facts.
A declared action the role does not list is BLOCK role_permits_action.

builtin.text: Every fact a decision needs must be supplied and valid; a missing or invalid fact is never permission.
Only declared areas are governed; anything in an undeclared area is blocked.
Only declared roles may act; unknown roles are blocked.
A participant may only take actions its role lists.
An action the rulebook does not know is denied, or waits for approval, as the rulebook says (otherwise).
A plan step happens where the earlier steps left the participant unless its action moves it there.

description: An action the rulebook does not know, with otherwise "deny", is BLOCK unknown_action.
With otherwise "wait-for-approval", an unknown action is PAUSE unknown_action and asks for an approval (anyone).
